content: click_count and conversion_count use different aggregation time bases. A conversion is attributed to the hour of its click and arrives up to four hours later, so the newest hours of a window undercount conversions against clicks and their rate reads low until attribution catches up. A rate that is low only in the newest hours while the earlier hours sit at baseline is attribution lag, not a degradation, and needs no action beyond a re-read after the lag
author: demo

content: Right after a planned operational change, the conversion tracking and aggregation check comes before any other check. Do not name a source as low quality until the measurement is confirmed unchanged, and say so in the purpose of the first check
